title: THE FINISHER ON A CONTROLLER
why: A cloud review of v26.54 to v27.30 found that the finisher could not be done on a controller. It read keyboard V and no pad button reached it, so player 2 on a pad was shown FINISH [V] over every downed pillager and could not do it. The pad has no melee button, so the finisher goes on Y, the button for the other close-in jobs (search the ring, help a teammate), held with a downed pillager in reach: the same 0.55 second hold, the same reach and points, and it does not swing the crowbar. Y keeps its other jobs, which win when they apply: helping a downed teammate, and searching a box or the ring when one is in reach underfoot. It follows CHANGE PAD BUTTONS (whatever button action 3 is on), the PAD list and the legend say so, and the prompt names the button as bound (Y, or TRIANGLE on a PlayStation pad), which the next build draws.
now: On a controller, hold Y on a downed pillager in reach to finish him.

edits.replacement: var PADLOGIC={KeyE:2,KeyR:2,KeyF:13,KeyT:5,KeyG:7,KeyQ:13,Space:0,KeyP:9,KeyX:2,ShiftLeft:10,ControlLeft:1,KeyM:12,KeyI:8,KeyV:3};   // v27.xx (feel2g): V, the finisher, is on action 3 (Y)

edits.anchor: padHold('PadSearch',(_yD&&!PAD.yAid)||(_xDown&&PAD.xMode==='KeyE'&&_xSearch));   // v25.xx (keyswap): the pad ring search (was keyboard X, which is the extraction now)
